title: 2007 AMC 10B Problem 3
statement: A college student drove his compact car \(120\) miles home for the weekend and averaged \(30\) miles per gallon. On the return trip the student drove his parents’ SUV and averaged only \(20\) miles per gallon. What was the average gas mileage, in miles per gallon, for the round trip?

solutions.text:
The student used \(\frac{120}{30}=4\) gallons driving home and \(\frac{120}{20}=6\) gallons returning, for \(10\) gallons over \(240\) miles.

The average is \(\frac{240}{10} = 24\) miles per gallon.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Average mileage is total distance divided by total gallons, not the average of the two rates
Find the gallons used each way, then divide \(240\) by their sum
